full_page.content:
1933, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 88 Cont.
Jan. Mrs. Anna Kloetzel - 71 - dizzy & forgetful
Two cases of unjust court procedures
Kenneth S. Brooks - Jackson, Mich. - 17 mo. - spasmodic paralisis James Garvin - pneumonia & erysipelas
John McEachin - 50 - has 8 children oldest 13 - youngest 1 - wife burried last Fri.
Madeline M. - 7 - Epileptic - parents once a year to holy Communion. Ed. Gorman .... Virginia Young - 5 mo. tumor on brain Geo. Little - 8 - T. B. hip T. K. - 52 - Arthritis - n.c.
1933, February
Feb. 2 Annabel Comer - 24 - had lost her voice completely, 8 months could not speak at all, came to Veneration of Cross Jan. 22nd, Wednesday ... following Sunday was at first frightened .....
Ida Denk - 57 - broke hip 15 year age - is seemingly always getting worse
Mrs. Gen. Kassap - 23 - inward goiter. ....
Page 89 Blank Page Page 90 Fef. Mrs. Gert. Eland - 35 - Husband wants divorce.
Mrs. L. O'B. Losing her mind
Babe Yvonne Irene Stapleton - 18 mo. -- birth injury - one side para- lysed - cannot hold up head - hopeless except by miracle - enrolled twice for year - To-day enrolled as a perpetual member - Mother pro- poses to read St. Theresa's life.
Cath. Salomona - 11 - enemic & heart
